{
  "participants": [

      "login": "Sjors",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "tested wallet workflows, identified block filter and change issues, and raised concern about immutable silent-payments wallet flag"
    },
    {
      "login": "josibake",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "provided architectural review on descriptor handling and warned against generic key-tweaking footguns"
    },
    {
      "login": "macgyver13",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "reported descriptor import failure with private keys and derivation path issues"
    },
    {
      "login": "PedroRosalba",
      "stance": "question",
      "note": "asked about the progress and blocking issues for the PR"
    },
    {
      "login": "rkrux",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "reviewed functional tests, noting hardcoded checksums and duplicate helpers"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:2204657999",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "silent payment wallets require full block scanning, so failing to disable block filters causes incorrect or failed rescanning",
      "quote": "while testing I found that it doesn't disable block filters.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2206657562",
        "rc:2218671774",
        "rc:2219135907"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:3117880896",
      "settled_by_quote": "rescan uses the slow version (when `-blockfilterindex` is enabled), as expected"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3070838431",
      "kind": "interface",
      "harm": "requiring a bech32 descriptor for change in an SP-only wallet prevents transaction creation and risks backup safety",
      "quote": "it insists on having a bech32 descriptor for change... It seems safer, for backups, to send change to the same silent payment address.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3098588297",
        "c:3102421425"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:3303689146",
      "settled_by_quote": "checked that the change went back to the descriptor (there are no other descriptors in the wallet)."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2231883781",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "importing sp descriptors with scan and spend private keys produced missing key warnings and failed to provide addresses",
      "quote": "I think this change is breaking the ability to import sp descriptor with private keys defined for scan and spend",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2233730246",
        "rc:2273059963"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2273967149",
      "settled_by_quote": "I can confirm the import warning is resolved."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2325279070",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "generic tweak addition functions on CKey and CPubKey introduce footguns that could be misused outside silent payments",
      "quote": "instead of a generic `CKey::TweakAdd` function that might be abused/footgunny.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3307718331"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:3307718331",
      "settled_by_quote": "I changed `CKey::TweakAdd()` to `CKey::ComputeBIP352Key()`"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3303689146",
      "kind": "interface",
      "harm": "silent payment descriptors cannot be imported into existing wallets because the silent-payments flag cannot be toggled",
      "quote": "It would be nicer if it just toggled the flag; I don't think anyone would accidentally perform such an import - and the flag is immutable via `setwalletflag`.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3307502671",
        "c:3311940236"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3486054123",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "harm": "hardcoding descriptor checksums in tests creates fragile test fixtures when descriptors change",
      "quote": "Let's avoid hardcoding the descriptor checksum and instead use the `descsum_create` utility function.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "Initial assessment populated from discussion. The PR is a draft blocked upstream on libsecp256k1 #1799. Outstanding open items include resolving wallet flag behavior when importing descriptors into existing wallets and minor test cleanups."
}

participants.note: tested wallet workflows, identified block filter and change issues, and raised concern about immutable silent-payments wallet flag
provided architectural review on descriptor handling and warned against generic key-tweaking footguns
reported descriptor import failure with private keys and derivation path issues
asked about the progress and blocking issues for the PR
reviewed functional tests, noting hardcoded checksums and duplicate helpers

claims.harm: silent payment wallets require full block scanning, so failing to disable block filters causes incorrect or failed rescanning
claims.quote: while testing I found that it doesn't disable block filters.
claims.settled_by_quote: rescan uses the slow version (when `-blockfilterindex` is enabled), as expected

claims.harm: requiring a bech32 descriptor for change in an SP-only wallet prevents transaction creation and risks backup safety
claims.quote: it insists on having a bech32 descriptor for change... It seems safer, for backups, to send change to the same silent payment address.
claims.settled_by_quote: checked that the change went back to the descriptor (there are no other descriptors in the wallet).

claims.harm: importing sp descriptors with scan and spend private keys produced missing key warnings and failed to provide addresses
claims.quote: I think this change is breaking the ability to import sp descriptor with private keys defined for scan and spend
claims.settled_by_quote: I can confirm the import warning is resolved.

claims.harm: generic tweak addition functions on CKey and CPubKey introduce footguns that could be misused outside silent payments
claims.quote: instead of a generic `CKey::TweakAdd` function that might be abused/footgunny.

claims.harm: silent payment descriptors cannot be imported into existing wallets because the silent-payments flag cannot be toggled
claims.quote: It would be nicer if it just toggled the flag; I don't think anyone would accidentally perform such an import - and the flag is immutable via `setwalletflag`.

claims.harm: hardcoding descriptor checksums in tests creates fragile test fixtures when descriptors change
claims.quote: Let's avoid hardcoding the descriptor checksum and instead use the `descsum_create` utility function.

result.notes: Initial assessment populated from discussion. The PR is a draft blocked upstream on libsecp256k1 #1799. Outstanding open items include resolving wallet flag behavior when importing descriptors into existing wallets and minor test cleanups.
